# pypi-hosted (pypi hosted) at http://gateway.test/gw
# set ARTIFACT_GATEWAY_TOKEN to a credential with access to this repository

## pip configuration — pip.conf
[global]
index-url = http://gateway.test/gw/pypi/pypi-hosted/simple/

## pip credentials — .netrc
machine gateway.test
login ci
password ${ARTIFACT_GATEWAY_TOKEN}

## twine configuration — .pypirc
[distutils]
index-servers = pypi-hosted

[pypi-hosted]
repository = http://gateway.test/gw/pypi/pypi-hosted/legacy/
username = ci
password = ${ARTIFACT_GATEWAY_TOKEN}

## publish
twine upload --repository pypi-hosted dist/*
